crossRefs.note: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and…
One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and…
Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of…
He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

translations.web: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.
translations.bsb: They plucked mallow among the shrubs, and the roots of the broom tree were their food.
translations.kjv: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
translations.asv: They pluck salt-wort by the bushes; And the roots of the broom are their food.
